text:
MCP stands for Model Context Protocol — it's an open standard that lets AI models like me connect to external tools and data sources in a structured way. Think of it as a USB standard for AI: instead of every app building its own custom integration with every AI, you build one MCP server that any compatible AI can talk to.

The server exposes things like tools the AI can call, resources it can read, and prompts it can use — and the AI client connects to it and discovers what's available. So you could have an MCP server for your database, your GitHub, your meeting system, whatever — and the AI just plugs in and gets those capabilities without anyone writing bespoke glue code each time.
